name: cua-hard/summit-run-of-show
description: Re-plan a two-day conference run of show: reconcile the Trello day/room lists with the venue's confirmed calendar bookings and the speaker changes in Yahoo Mail (a corrected swap, a withdrawal filled from a local registration export, an approved move, a declined request), drag every session into the right list in start-time order, update the bookings calendar, confirm new slots to the speakers and export the final programme as CSV.
